# Set-ZbxTemplateDashboard

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a template dashboard.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxTemplateDashboard [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateDashboard>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Uuid <string>] [-DisplayPeriod <int>] [-AutoStart <bool>] [-Page <ZabbixTemplateDashboardUpdatePageRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A template dashboard is a dashboard a template defines; each host linked to the template shows it with that host's data. The Set-ZbxTemplateDashboard cmdlet changes the template dashboards given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with templatedashboard.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every template dashboard the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed template dashboards back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a template dashboard

```powershell
Set-ZbxTemplateDashboard -InputObject 'Web App overview' -DisplayPeriod 60
```

Makes the template dashboard Web App overview show each page for 60 seconds in slide show mode.

### Example 2: Change a template dashboard and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxTemplateDashboard -InputObject 'Web App overview' -DisplayPeriod 60 -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the template dashboard Web App overview back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateDashboard>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Uuid (ByPropertyName), -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `int`: Bound to -DisplayPeriod (ByPropertyName). A number.
- `bool`: Bound to -AutoStart (ByPropertyName). True or false.
- `ZabbixTemplateDashboardUpdatePageRequest[]`: Bound to -Page (ByPropertyName). pages of a ZabbixTemplateDashboardUpdateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.
